title: Protected cost unlock for FM authorization / Super Admin override
features: CostRecordService.update allows exceptional unlock when Next.js attaches verified _protectedAction=finance.cost.unlock_edit with _authorityMode facility_manager or platform_override
Default lock for non-draft claims remains; unlock is not global

deploymentSemantics.deploymentRequired: Pack intent: a new Web App deploy is required to apply this source release when cutting from the repo. Not a live deployment status flag.
deploymentSemantics.appsScriptRedeploy: Required — replace CostRecordService.gs and cut a new Web App version.

notes: Deploy must include updated CostRecordService.gs, then a new Web App version.
V1 protected actions: exceptional cost unlock only changes Apps Script; other protected actions are Next.js authoritative.
